claims.claim: Complete engine with compressor and all the operators for Toyota Venza/Camry/Sienna/Highlander
claims.evidence: Witness photos show an engine bay with intake/airbox, hoses, wiring, and visible transmission/gearbox mounting area, but the make/model/compatibility and presence/condition of a compressor and all required components are not readable/confirmed.
No import documents, markings, VIN/engine code, or Belgium sourcing evidence is shown in the witness report.
No start/run video, diagnostic screen, fault codes, or test results are shown in the witness report.
No audio/video of running engine is provided; photos only show the engine bay.
No odometer/engine hour reading or engine code/mileage evidence is shown.
Photos show used/dusty components but do not prove whether the engine has been opened internally.

risks.risk: Engine make/model/variant is not readable; compatibility with Toyota Venza/Camry/Sienna/Highlander cannot be confirmed from the photos.
risks.proof: Clear close-up photos of the engine identification plate/engine code (and transmission code if applicable), plus a photo showing the exact engine label/part number.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used Toyota-compatible engine assembly with unknown variant/compatibility risk.

risks.risk: Whether it truly includes the compressor and all required accessories/operators for the intended application is not confirmed.
risks.proof: Photos showing the compressor clearly (front/side view), and a checklist photo of included items (compressor, alternator, starter, ECU if included, major sensors, hoses/radiator connections as applicable).
risks.if_unproven: Price as engine assembly only (missing/unknown accessories), assuming buyer may need to source missing parts.

risks.risk: Working/test status is not evidenced; could have hidden faults (misfire, sensor issues, overheating history, oil leaks).
risks.proof: Video of a cold start and short run with no warning lights, plus a diagnostic scan screenshot showing no active fault codes.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst-case: may require repairs).

risks.risk: Internal condition (compression, timing, head gasket) cannot be verified from exterior photos.
risks.proof: Compression test results and leak-down test results (photos/screenshots) or a mechanic’s test report with readings.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown internal condition (worst-case: potential rebuild risk).

risks.risk: Transmission/gearbox condition and whether it shifts properly is not confirmed; photos only show mounting area.
risks.proof: Video of gear engagement/shifting (if testable) or proof of transmission type and service condition (gear oil condition photo, transmission code).
risks.if_unproven: Price as engine-only value with transmission condition uncertain.

risks.risk: Completeness of wiring harness, sensors, ECU, and cooling components is not confirmed; missing parts can make installation impossible or costly.
risks.proof: Photo inventory of all included harnesses/sensors/ECU and connectors; close-ups of key sensors and ECU part number if present.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown completeness (buyer may need to source missing electronics/sensors).

proof_requests: Send clear close-up photos of the engine code/identification plate and transmission code (readable).
Send a video of the engine starting from cold and running briefly, showing no warning lights.
Send a diagnostic scan screenshot (fault codes) from a proper OBD scan.
Show the compressor clearly and confirm it is included (front/side close-ups).
Provide a photo inventory checklist of what is included (ECU, wiring harness, alternator, starter, major sensors, hoses/ducts, and any cooling-related parts).
Provide compression/leak test results (screenshots/photos) or a mechanic’s written report with readings.
response.reason: The witness confirms an engine assembly is present, but the key details needed to price safely in Abuja (exact engine variant/compatibility, confirmed included compressor/accessories, and verified working/test results) are not evidenced in the report. Without those, any price would be too speculative.
